base: Use attached screenshot ONLY as baby-goose character identity/style reference, never reproduce UI, colour tiles, text, buttons or layout. ONE full-body BABY GOOSE, large round head, tiny short neck, plump pear-shaped white body, small rounded scalloped wings like screenshot, tiny orange webbed feet, tiny orange triangular beak, small dot eye. Much closer to the screenshot's cute simple baby chefs than an adult long-neck goose. Thin confident slightly hand-drawn continuous black contour, delicate sparse loose crosshatch only at wing folds, flat 2D children's cookbook ink illustration. Warm off-white solid body, genuine transparent PNG background (NO paper rectangle, no checkerboard painted in). NO ground shadow, no scenery, no text. Centered square image, full figure and props inside 6% padding. Foot baseline near bottom. Small tied triangular neckerchief. Silhouette readable at 32 pixels. Wing shoulders clearly connected to body, no floating hands. Preserve baby proportions even for stretched-neck poses.
